days.title: Pickup from Delhi and move to Shimla
days.body: Pick up from Delhi Airport/Railways station and way towards Shimla by Private Vehicle. Reach Shimla in the afternoon time. Check – in at the Hotel and some leisure: later visit “Jakhu Temple” – a very well-known temple situated at the top of the hill to seek blessings of the almighty. An hour-long enthralling trek takes you to the renowned temple known for stunning vistas and presence of numerous monkeys. Now head to the bustling mall & indulge in a shopping spree. Also, explore the Ridge and the State Museum for a quick and interesting peep into the city’s history and culture. Than Evening time return Back to Hotel for take the Dinners and Overnight Stay at the Hotel in Shimla.

days.title: Shimla – (Kufri)
days.body: Morning after Breakfast, Getto Ready; visit to Kufri isfamousfor its Himalayan National Park, Pony and Yak Ride and One can see the endless Himalayan Panorama from Kufri. Later visit Naldehra -Naldehra is Famous Golf Course. Than Evening time return Back to Hotel for take the Dinners and Overnight Stay at the Hotel in Shimla.

days.title: Head to Manali – (visit to Kullu)
days.body: Morning after Breakfast, Check - out from the Hotel; drive your way to Manali in private vehicle. En-route visits the Kullu market which is famous for its handicrafts and shawls. Collect some souvenirs and head to. Reach Manali in the late Evening time. Check - in at the Hotel for take the dinner and overnight stay at the Hotel in Manali. ABOUT KULLU Kullu (1220m) was once known as Kulanthapitha - the end of the habitable world. Beyond rose the forbidding heights of the Greater Himalaya and by the banks of the shining river Beas lay the fabled Silver Valley. Kullu got its first memorable access only after independence. The long centuries of seclusion have however allowed the area to retain considerable measures of its traditional charm. Here is the core of an intricate web of numerous valleys, each of which is a visual delight and seems more beautiful than the other. The Silver Valley has nature's treasures that lie carelessly scattered as flowers. This wealth nestles by every tree in the splendid forests, bursts forth in the blooms and in the fruit of every orchard. Here are riches which cannot be measured and echo down the ages with the words of every myth and ancient legend and glow in the warm smiles of its gentle people. There is pleasure in every step you take in these enchanted valleys and in every gurgle you hear in the clear mountain streams.

days.title: Manali – Local Sightseeing
days.body: After Breakfast Get to Ready, visit “HADIMBA TEMPLE” Built in 1553 with a superbly crafted four tiered pagoda roof, it isfamous for its exquisitely carved doorway .“CLUB HOUSE” The Club House with its comprehensive facilitiesthat include a rollerskating rink, an auditorium, billiards rooms, a library, a bar and restaurant makes wonderful outing for the day.” Tibetan Monastery, Van Vihar, and“VASHIST” Well known for its hot springs. There are old temples dedicated to the sage Vashisth and to Lord Rama. than Evening time Return Back to Hotel for take the Dinners and Overnight Stay at the Hotel in Manali.

days.title: Manali – Solang valley
days.body: Morning after Breakfast, Get to Ready, visit to snow point Solang Valley. Than Evening time Return to Hotel for take the Dinner and overnight stay at the Hotel in Manali. On the road to Keylong is the Nehru Kund (6km) which is clear water spring scenic spot named after the Late Pt. Jawaharlal Nehru. Kothi (12km) is a picturesque village and has a thrilling view of the deep gorge through which the Beasswiftly races. The beautiful Rahalla falls(16km) are at at altitude of 2500m.

days.title: Head to Dharamshala – (Visit Local Sight seen)
days.body: Morning after Breakfast, Check - out from the Hotel and drive to Dharamshala & visit the Local Sightseeing. Kangra Valley , HPCA Stadium , Tea Garden , Naddi , Bagsu nag water fall and temple . Overnight Stay at the Hotel in Dalhousie.

days.title: Head to Dalhousie – (Visit Local Sight seen)
days.body: Morning after Breakfast, Check - out from the Hotel and drive to Dalhousie & visit the Satdhara Falls. The waterfall is set amidst hills and offers beautiful views of snow-covered mountains, surrounded by pine and Deodar trees. We’ll walk to this picturesque spot and then head towards Panchpula, which is only a few kilometers away from here. Now head to visit the Dainkund Peak, the highest peak in Dalhousie and popularly known as the singing hill. There is an Indian Air Force base at the peak of Dainkund and a left turn from there is the Pholani Devi Temple, which is the prime attraction. Reach Dalhousie in late Evening time. Check - in at the Hotel for take the Dinner and Overnight Stay at the Hotel in Dalhousie.

days.title: Explore Khajjiar
days.body: Morning after Breakfast, Get to Ready: Head to Khajjiar. Enjoy the serenity of the Khajjiar Lake. Khajjiar is often referred as “Mini Switzerland of India”.*Optional activities – Paragliding services, Horse Riding, Zorbing, Rappelling, Rock Climbing and River Crossing. Than Evening time return Back to Hotel for take the Dinner and Overnight Stay at the Hotel in Dalhousie.

days.title: Departure transfer to Airport / Railway Station
days.body: Morning after Breakfast, Check - out from the Hotel Drive back to Delhi . After that you will be transfer to Airport / Railway Station by Private Vehicle in Delhi .
